nodes.name: Wasender delivers here
nodes.notes: Set this as each Wasender session's webhook URL — Dubai: https://n8n.mutholab.com/webhook/wecon-whatsapp-chat?account=dubai — Eyad: https://n8n.mutholab.com/webhook/wecon-whatsapp-chat?account=eyad. Every delivery is mirrored into the CRM chat tables AND forwarded unchanged to the 'Wecon WA Bot' webhook.

nodes.name: Wecon WA Bot (unchanged)
nodes.notes: Replays the delivery to the existing bot's webhook so that workflow needs no changes.

nodes.name: CRM Chat · Parse
nodes.notes: Mirrors every 1:1 message into wa_conversations / wa_messages for the CRM Conversations view. Text only. Parallel to the bot — never replies.

nodes.name: CRM Chat · Receipt
nodes.notes: Delivery / read receipts for CRM-sent messages (matched on wa_id).

nodes.name: CRM Chat · Claim event
nodes.notes: Insert-once replay guard: 409 means this delivery was already processed.

nodes.name: CRM Chat · Lead by phone
nodes.notes: Attach the thread to an existing CRM lead by the last 9 digits.

nodes.name: CRM Chat · Sent by CRM?
nodes.notes: fromMe echo of a CRM-sent message → already stored, skip the bubble.

nodes.name: CRM Chat · Bump unread
nodes.notes: Atomic unread + preview update on the thread.

meta.description: Inbound for the CRM Conversations view. Wasender sessions call THIS webhook; it mirrors every message into wa_conversations / wa_messages (text only) and forwards the raw delivery to the existing Wecon WA Bot webhook, which stays untouched. Per-session URLs: https://n8n.mutholab.com/webhook/wecon-whatsapp-chat?account=dubai and ?account=eyad.
